quick.panel: A small menu at the side of the screen with your tools, so you can use them while watching the game. F10 opens and closes it; PgUp opens the full panel.
quick.close: Closes the menu and takes you back to the game. Modes that are on stay on. Shortcut Esc or F10.
quick.search: Searches every tool by name, like 'fly' or 'copy'; results come from all sections. In the Players section it searches their names.

group.self: Your own tools: flying, invisibility, protection and healing.
group.travel: Quick travel: to the map waypoint, to coordinates, or back to your last spot.
group.players: Quick actions on one player: move them, go to them, heal them or freeze them.
group.spawn: Spawns a temporary horse, wagon, animal or person next to you.
group.vehicle: Repairs or fixes the wagon or horse you are using.
group.dev: Developer tools: coordinates, object IDs and clearing the area.
group.world: Weather, time and announcements; they change for every player.

target.text: Type the citizen ID of the player you want, like 12. For a session number put # first, like #5. Or press their name in the list below.

quick.online: Players online now. Press any name and their citizen ID fills the box above and their actions appear.
quick.full: Opens the full admin panel with every page. Shortcut PgUp.
quick.active: How many modes are on for you now, like Invisible or Noclip. Each stays until you turn it off.

quick.title: Quick menu
quick.searchPlayers: Search a player name or ID…
quick.pickPlayer: Type a citizen ID or pick a player to see the actions.
quick.offline: This player is not in the game right now, so these actions do not apply.
quick.frozen: This player is frozen right now.
quick.selfNote: This is you, so some actions do not apply.
